PASTURED POULTRY PROFIT PLANNER · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

Does a batch of pastured chickens pay you for your time?

Enter your batch size, losses, feed, processing and prices. The planner works out profit per batch, per bird and per hour of your own labour, the dressed price per pound you need to break even, and how the season changes with mortality, feed price, sales channel and flock size.

Planning arithmetic on your own numbers and stated assumptions.

1. Your batches

Birds lost still ate part of a bird’s feed; the planner counts half. Weeks to finish is shown for your reference and does not change the numbers.

3. What it costs

Result

Questions people ask

Is raising pastured chickens profitable?

It can be, but the margin per bird is thin and labour is the swing factor. The planner shows profit before and after paying yourself, so you can see the hourly return on your own time, not just a profit figure.

How much does it cost to raise a pastured broiler?

Chicks, feed, processing, bedding and fuel, then your time. Feed is usually the largest line. The planner prices each batch and gives a break-even price per dressed pound.

How many batches a year can I run?

That depends on your climate and brooding set-up. Enter the number you will actually run; the planner multiplies one batch out to a season and spreads equipment over its life.

Is this agricultural or financial advice?

No. It is arithmetic on the numbers you type in. Licensing, processing rules, avian disease, predators, insurance, sales-tax and labelling are out of scope.

Not decided

Licensing and on-farm or custom processing rules, avian disease and biosecurity, predators and weather, pasture and rotation, insurance, sales-tax and labelling rules, local demand for your price, and tax treatment of farm income. Feed, chick and processing prices vary a lot by region and season; the defaults are placeholders, not forecasts.

Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (season_run, example_loaded) are counted only in local storage on your device. The counts can be deleted with the button below. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are honoured.
